clips.start_words: But the fact is there's a missing ingredient
clips.caption:
Andrew Carnegie, once the richest man alive, hired a researcher named Napoleon Hill to study the truly wealthy — Henry Ford, Thomas Edison, J.P. Morgan — and write down exactly what they knew that nobody else did.

Hill published it in 1926. Henry Ford saw the finished book and killed it — "we don't want people to know the truth" — and had it pulled from the market. What came back years later was a watered-down version. What came back after that, even more watered down, was Think and Grow Rich. Millions have read it. Almost none got the actual secret.

Comment RISE and I'll send you what got cut.

#disclosure #secretsocieties #manifestation #awakening #history #kevintrudeau

No wealthy family. No college. No connections — just a welder's son who flunked out of high school.

At fifteen, that changed. He was taken in by an organization called The Brotherhood, and they taught him how the brain actually works as a transmitter and receiver of frequency — not as theory, as something you use.

He made millions before he turned eighteen. Not from talent he was born with. From a formula somebody finally handed him.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the formula.

#brotherhood #lawofattraction #frequency #manifestation #awakening #kevintrudeau

Skeptics call it anecdotal. It isn't.

There are motorized devices paraplegics control just by thought — no hands, no buttons, just a signal from the brain. There's a keypad with no keys: think "cat," and CAT appears on the screen. A small machine that moves a ball left, right, forward, back, by thought alone.

If a thought can move a wheelchair or a ball, it can move the rest of your life. The brain transmits and receives frequency, and those frequencies affect physical matter at the quantum level. That part isn't belief anymore. It's measured.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the research.

#manifestation #lawofattraction #frequency #consciousness #awakening #kevintrudeau
